statement_refuted: A law-uniform modulus of characteristic-function continuity at fixed frequency follows from a small operator/Hilbert-Schmidt perturbation of the quadratic-form matrix under only independent density caps.
counterexample: A0=diag(1,1,1,0,0), Aeps=A0+eps(e4e5^T+e5e4^T); phase-align the first three cap-one laws at frequency one and take X4,X5 uniform on a length-one interval centered at sqrt(pi/(2eps)). Then ||Aeps-A0||op=eps but |phi_Aeps(1)-phi_A0(1)| approaches 2.
scope_note: This does not refute QFORM. It refutes deleting a small higher-rank tail by absolute characteristic-function perturbation without using additional product geometry.
